about: M3 state runners: death ramp, stagger dip, knockdown. Every number names its source. Start values from donor games, to be retuned on OUR clips before they are final (BRIEF: template layer only).

death.source: Hellish Quart PuppetMaster stateSettings: killDuration 1, deadMuscleWeight 0.01, deadMuscleDamper 2, maxFreezeSqrVelocity 0.02 (docs/parts-lab/combat-physics-comparison-three-games.md; Strategy M3). The squared-speed unit is the brief's; the freeze check sums the squared linear speed of each body.

stagger.ease_in_source: own: HQ drops the weights at once; 0.05 s (3 ticks) avoids a one-tick pop
stagger.hold_up_source: Hellish Quart PuppetMasterWeightsFSM 'toGetHit': lower the muscles, hold 0.5 s, FloatInterpolate 0.35 s back up (BRIEF M3 'strength down for 0.5 s, back over 0.35 s')
stagger.chain_targets_source: own: the chain bodies' roles (src/chain.mjs spec role, default the part id) get the same torso/leg value 0.6 as the humanoid rows, and the tail goes looser at 0.4 (nothing holds it up, it should whip); spine and head already had 0.6. The humanoid keys above are unchanged. Retune on our clips.
stagger.targets_source: BRIEF M3 'arm 0.9 / torso 0.6 / 0.12' read as HQ HandMuscleWeakener muscle weights arm 0.9 / forearm 0.6 / hand 0.12 for the arm chain, torso and legs at the torso value 0.6 (own reading of the ambiguous '0.12'); retune on our clips

helmet.source: own: a closed helm about 1.6 kg and 26 cm across (Half Sword head capsule 23 cm + a 3 cm shell), popped up 1.9 m/s and spun on the cut; Strategy 2026-10-26: the helmet flies as a prop (M5); retune on the clip

edge.source: own: the blade segment is tested at 6 interpolations between its start-of-tick and end-of-tick poses; a part counts as cut THROUGH when the blade passes within 0.6 of the capsule radius of its axis (GM sweeps the blade through organ colliders, A: BRIEF M5). The threshold that turns this into a cut is the evaluator's (rules.json)

knockdown.source: TABG RagdollHandler.Fall: damage over 60 falls 0.2 s, push force over 80 falls 0.5 s, down 2 s, recovery 0.3 per second (docs/parts-lab/combat-physics-comparison-five-games.md, B5). fall_strength 0.1 is the 'fall' state of stiffness_by_state in the role table (own). Counter-based thresholds (60 of 120) are M4 rows.
